coords: u = (i + 0.5) / N west->east, v = (j + 0.5) / N north->south

height.f32.desc: Height 0..1, row-major (index = j*N + i, j = north->south). Land > sea_level. Sea cells hold the sea floor. Lakes hold their flat surface. Pits are filled so every land cell drains to the sea or a lake.

height_512.f32.desc: Box downsample of height.f32 for quick previews.

river.f32.desc: Flow accumulation on the eroded, filled height: number of upstream cells (each cell = 1). A river shows from about 600; the big named rivers reach 1e5+.

lake.u8.desc: 0 = no lake, else 1 + index into layout lakes (see lakes below).

snow.u8.desc: Snow cover 0..255 (height against a snow line that drops northward, north faces hold more).

region.u8.desc: Region id (see regions). The border between the Reach and the eastern kingdom follows the traced border river.

pois.json.desc: Every place: u, v, kind, name, variant (castles), provisional, height and region at the spot.

coast.json.desc: Shore polylines (marching squares at sea level, simplified).

rivers.json.desc: Named rivers and streams traced on the drainage tree.
